checks.reason: Intercom documents regional hosts in prose, not in a machine-readable contract the pinned OpenAPI document can carry beyond its server list. Compare the Regional Hosting table with the provider region map: US api.intercom.io, Europe api.eu.intercom.io, Australia api.au.intercom.io, and the note that api.intercom.io attempts to route other regions.

Authentication and teammate scoping are documentation prose. Confirm access tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer, are issued to the installing or regenerating teammate, and that conversation access is limited by that teammate as well as the app scopes; OAuth remains out of scope.

evidence.teammate: An Access Token is issued to the teammate who installed the app on the workspace, or who last regenerated the token.

checks.reason: The version header contract is prose. Confirm Intercom-Version on a request overrides the app setting, and compare the current changelog version with the pinned 2.18 document before moving the pin.

The acting-teammate semantics are field descriptions the endpoint digests cover only structurally. Confirm admin_id stays required and names the admin performing the action on close, snooze, open and assignment, that assignee_id 0 unassigns both teammate and team, and that reply, note, tag and untag still take admin_id as the authoring admin.

Rate limits and error statuses are prose. Compare the private-app default (10,000 calls per minute per workspace, metered in 10-second windows) with the default admission budget, and the HTTP response table (401, 403 api_plan_restricted, 404, 409, 429 with optional Retry-After, 406 without Accept) with the error table.

Whether skip_notifications suppresses customer-facing messages is not stated anywhere machine-readable. The pinned 2.18 contract documents the flag on close, open and assignment only as an option to disable notifications (available from 2.15), and snooze has none. Intercom's help center says a teammate close signals the conversation-rating automation and fires Closed-state workflows that can ask the customer for a rating, without saying the flag or an API close stops them. Recheck both sources: if Intercom documents that skip_notifications suppresses CSAT and workflow messages, close may return to a non-destructive write.

evidence.flag: skip_notifications: Option to disable notifications when closing a conversation. Available from API version 2.15.
